findings.desc: B-9958 smoke does not directly prove default dry-run no-write behavior for the mutating writer surfaces. The smoke snapshots observe/no-mutation and checks drift failure writes no proposals, but it never snapshots stores around playbook_seed_propose_batch without apply, playbook_candidate_batch_approve without apply, or playbook_auto_promotion_apply dry-run. A regression that creates proposals/candidates or mutates learning state during default dry-run could slip while the current apply-path assertions still pass.

B-9958 lacks enough CLI-level coverage for the new command surfaces and undercovers M7 status/readiness. The recorded smoke invokes createPlaybookHandlers directly and checks MAIN_TOOLS/COMMAND_POLICIES/PROCESS_FACT_LEVELS membership, but it does not execute the actual lattice CLI for the CLI-marked verification intents, nor does it call playbook_promotion_status to assert the V1 readiness and V2 disabled posture promised by CHK-005. CLI parser/schema/default flag behavior and status text/json output could regress without this smoke failing.
